kind: Unified full-file review scope and current-content fingerprint evidence
assembly_actions: Read existing audit metadata, enumerate paths, hash bytes, count lines, compare Git snapshots and reconcile review attestations. No new semantic code review, test execution, benchmark or repository edit.

scope_definition.production: src/**/*.php, recursively including PHP files directly under src/
scope_definition.tests: tests/**/*.php, recursively including PHP files directly under tests/
scope_definition.matching: Repository-relative POSIX paths under the named directory whose filename ends exactly with .php.
scope_definition.native_fixture_suffix: .php.fixture is explicitly excluded from both primary counts.
scope_definition.documentation_configuration_and_benchmar: Outside src/**/*.php and tests/**/*.php; not included in the 169/229 counts even when the file itself is PHP.

/root/attributes_audit.assignment_note: Production scope is the explicit accepted agent inventory; production overlaps are retained rather than redistributed. Test assignment comes from its separate assignment inventory.

/root/core_audit.assignment_note: Production scope is the explicit accepted agent inventory; production overlaps are retained rather than redistributed. Test assignment comes from its separate assignment inventory.

/root/parameters_audit.assignment_note: Production scope is the explicit accepted agent inventory; production overlaps are retained rather than redistributed. Test assignment comes from its separate assignment inventory.

test_read_reuse.note: Evidence attests complete reading of all 57 files without a numeric reuse split; none is inferred.

/root.assignment_note: Production scope is the explicit accepted agent inventory; production overlaps are retained rather than redistributed. Test assignment comes from its separate assignment inventory.

changes_since_initial_audit.note: Includes the new external-lookup regression file and PreparedCallable regression changes introduced before the dedicated test-quality review baseline. Initial hashes remain separate from the later full-file test review snapshot.

fingerprints.per_file_content: SHA256 of exact file bytes, with no newline, encoding or whitespace normalization.
fingerprints.line_count: Count LF bytes plus one when nonempty content does not end in LF. An empty file has zero lines.
fingerprints.aggregate_serialization: Sort relative POSIX paths by UTF-8 byte order. For each file concatenate UTF8(path), NUL, lowercase ASCII content SHA256, NUL, decimal ASCII byte length, NUL, decimal ASCII line count, LF. SHA256 the concatenation. Absolute checkout paths and review labels are excluded.

parent_attestation.source: Parent /root task delivered to /root/attributes_audit for this aggregation.
parent_attestation.statement: Root fully read all 14 src/Exception/*.php files and src/FactoryInterface.php, plus all 12 test support/bootstrap/mutation files in root-test-inventory.json.

additional_context_reads_not_promoted_to.reason: Some entries explicitly name sections or cross-boundary context. They do not independently establish an additional full-file review; the primary attribution lists remain unchanged.

outside_primary_counts.other_paths: Benchmarks and any other paths outside the two primary scopes are excluded. No exhaustive review claim for these paths is made by this scope manifest.
outside_primary_counts.metadata_only_note: These inventories record current content identity, not additional full-file semantic review. Their lines are not included in primary line totals.

limitations: This artifact aggregates the agents' explicit review attestations and the parent's statement; assembly itself does not reread code or independently replay validation.
Parameters production evidence supplies paths and a baseline commit, not per-file hashes. Baseline hashes are derived from that Git commit and labelled accordingly.
Where content changed after full-file review, baseline and current hashes are both retained with the reviewed/validated fix provenance; no additional whole-file reread is invented.
Full file coverage is review scope evidence, not a proof of bug absence, complete behavioral coverage, or a fresh mutation campaign.
